reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is cryptocurrency chart analysis and Cardano price prediction, with discussion of Bitcoin, Ethereum, market cycles, and projected price levels. Membership and Patreon references are presented as access to charts, shirts, or Discord updates, not as conditions for purchasing an asset, transferring funds, or providing trading credentials. The warning about hypothetical people seeking money or account management is framed as protection against possible third-party contact rather than as a solicitation by the video.

i'm still expecting the market to drop
the support for that is between 19.6 cents and 15.1 cents

opening.argument: Judge, the invitation to join a paid membership appears alongside a forecast that Cardano could rise after further lows. The speaker offers members access to charts and daily Discord updates, then describes a point at which Cardano can start rising again. That pairing can steer a viewer from an appreciation thesis toward paid access to the speaker's continuing guidance, even though the video does not explicitly tell viewers to buy ADA.

make sure to check out our youtube memberships and our patreon if you want access to all of our charts and if you want access to our daily discord updates

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense correctly identifies chart analysis, but that does not resolve what the membership invitation does in context. The speaker links membership to charts and daily updates, while presenting a prospective Cardano recovery. There is no stated requirement to transfer funds or credentials; the concern is the softer invitation to pay for guidance around a possible gain.

citations.quote: check out our youtube memberships and our patreon if you want access to all of our charts and if you want access to our daily discord updates
and then we can start finally going up again after that

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Paid access to charts is not a request to buy a token, and a forecast of eventual recovery is not a promised return. The speaker also predicts substantial downside for ADA before any rise. Those qualifications make the cited passages consistent with market commentary and an optional content membership, not a token-purchase solicitation.

if you want access to all of our charts and if you want access to our daily discord updates

opening.argument: Judge, consider the combination of a crypto price-prediction video, an external membership link, and an unusually large upside scenario. The speaker raises the possibility of Ethereum reaching $14,000 in a later cycle and describes altcoins moving upward; the description directs viewers to a Patreon membership. The warnings about risk do not erase the potential pull of those forecasts. This is not proof of a guaranteed return, but the optimistic projections and paid channel together warrant scrutiny as promotion around anticipated asset appreciation.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to bearish forecasts, but a bearish near-term view can coexist with an enticing later upside scenario. Nor does describing Patreon as access to updates settle whether the forecasts help attract paying viewers. The issue is the combined effect of the price narrative and membership invitation, not a claim that the video asks for trading credentials.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The $14,000 figure is a conditional Ethereum scenario, not a Cardano return promise or an instruction to purchase either asset. The same discussion says Ethereum may first fall to $1,200, while the description warns that crypto investors can lose money. An external link for content membership does not establish a token-purchase pathway.

citations.quote: I still see Ethereum dropping to about $1,200 at the bare minimum
if we want Ethereum to actually start a move to maybe $14,000
Crypto is high risk, you can lose your money.

opening.argument: Judge, the chart discussion also functions as a recurring invitation to follow this speaker's forecasts. The video opens with membership and Patreon access, develops a detailed Cardano downside-and-recovery scenario, and closes by offering members charts and daily updates. The analysis can therefore be read as a demonstration of the guidance available through the paid channel. That promotional role matters even without an explicit buy order: it places an asset-appreciation narrative next to a route for deeper participation in the speaker's coverage.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the membership references as separate from the analysis. But the opening and closing invitations surround a forecast that first identifies possible Cardano lows and then anticipates a rise. Calling the material chart analysis does not rule out its simultaneous promotional function; the narrower question is whether that function is enough to justify concern, despite the absence of an explicit asset purchase request.

citations.quote: make sure to check out our YouTube Memberships and our Patreon
the support for that is between 19.6 cents and 15.1 cents
if you want access to all of our charts and if you want access to our daily discord updates

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A creator can promote optional access to their charts without promoting the purchase of Cardano. Here the cited forecast includes possible further losses, and the description explicitly disclaims financial advice and endorsement. The prosecution identifies promotion of the creator's content, but its quotes do not show a request to buy a token or a promise of gains from doing so.
